title.en: Eats365 Scan-to-Order — mobile-first food ordering that restaurants can brand in minutes
title.zh: Eats365 掃碼點餐 — 以手機為核心的自助點餐體驗，讓餐廳快速呈現品牌風格

short_description.en: A responsive web ordering experience for Eats365's BYOD scan-to-order module — from QR landing to menu browsing, customization, and checkout — designed to cut front-of-house steps while keeping orders accurate and on-brand.
short_description.zh: 為 Eats365 掃碼點餐（BYOD）模組設計的響應式網頁點餐體驗，涵蓋掃碼進入、瀏覽菜單、客製化選項到結帳的完整流程，減少樓面人手步驟，同時確保點餐準確並貼合餐廳品牌。

category.zh: UX/UI 設計 · 網頁設計

subtitle.en: Turning a Five-Step Ordering Flow into One Tap on the Customer's Phone
subtitle.zh: 把五步點餐流程，濃縮成顧客手機上的一次操作

body.en:
Hong Kong restaurants often juggle menu handoffs, order-taking, confirmation, manual POS entry, and kitchen tickets — five or more steps before a single order is complete. Eats365's scan-to-order (BYOD) model digitizes that journey: guests scan a QR code and order directly on their phone, with orders syncing instantly to POS and kitchen systems — no extra hardware required.

This project translates that product promise into a polished, brand-ready ordering web experience. The design supports delivery and pickup modes, rich digital menus with photography and descriptions, and a checkout flow that feels as natural on mobile as it does on desktop — helping restaurants serve more guests during peak hours without adding floor pressure.
body.zh:
香港餐廳的點餐流程往往涉及遞菜單、接單、確認、手動輸入 POS、再送廚房單——一個顧客至少要走五個以上步驟。Eats365 掃碼點餐（BYOD）把這條路徑數碼化：顧客掃描 QR Code 即可在手機上點餐，訂單即時同步至 POS 與廚房系統，無需額外硬體。

此專案將這套產品價值轉化為可上線、可品牌化的點餐網頁體驗。設計支援外送與自取模式、以圖文呈現的豐富數位菜單，以及在手機與桌面都流暢的結帳流程——讓餐廳在繁忙時段服務更多顧客，同時減輕樓面壓力。

subtitle.en: The Hard Part Isn't the Menu — It's Making Self-Service Feel Effortless
subtitle.zh: 難點不在菜單本身，而是讓自助點餐感覺毫不費力

body.en:
Scan-to-order sounds simple, but the UX friction hides in the details:

• Mode complexity — Guests may dine in, order for delivery, or pick up; the interface must make the right path obvious without extra taps.
• Menu depth at small screen size — Restaurants need room for categories, modifiers, combo sets, and special notes — without overwhelming a phone screen.
• Multi-guest, one table — Several people may order from their own devices; the experience should still feel unified when it's time to pay.
• Brand flexibility — Every restaurant has its own identity; the system can't look like a generic template.
• Speed under pressure — During rush hour, every extra step costs turnover. Clarity and visual hierarchy matter as much as feature coverage.
body.zh:
掃碼點餐聽起來簡單，但 UX 摩擦往往藏在細節裡：

• 模式複雜 — 顧客可能堂食、外送或自取；介面必須讓正確路徑一目了然，不需多餘點擊。
• 小螢幕承載深度菜單 — 餐廳需要分類、改碼、套餐與備註空間，卻不能讓手機畫面過載。
• 多人同桌、各自點餐 — 多位顧客可能用各自裝置點餐，結帳時仍須感覺是一張統一訂單。
• 品牌彈性 — 每家餐廳都有獨特形象，系統不能看起來像通用模板。
• 繁忙時段的速度 — 高峰時每一個多餘步驟都影響翻檯率；資訊層級與清晰度與功能完整同樣重要。

subtitle.en: A Structured Flow from Scan to Checkout
subtitle.zh: 從掃碼到結帳的結構化流程

body.en:
The solution breaks the ordering journey into clear, repeatable stages:

1. Entry & service mode — A branded landing screen lets guests choose delivery or pickup and confirm location, setting context before they browse.
2. Discovery — Home screen with search, promotional carousel, and restaurant listings helps guests find what they want quickly — or jump straight into a bound restaurant menu after scanning a table QR.
3. Restaurant detail — Hero imagery, ratings, cuisine tags, delivery info, and operating hours build trust before the first item is added.
4. Menu navigation — Tabbed categories (Recommended, Noodles, Sets, etc.) keep long menus scannable; sticky cart summary shows item count and running total at all times.
5. Item customization — Modifier groups (e.g. meat selection with price deltas) use clear radio controls and quantity steppers, reducing order errors at the source.
6. Cart & checkout — Desktop uses a persistent side cart; mobile uses a bottom action bar — both leading to a streamlined guest checkout form.

Across mobile and desktop, the same design language — Eats365 orange accents, clean white surfaces, appetizing food photography — keeps the experience consistent whether guests order on their phone at the table or browse on a larger screen.
body.zh:
解法將點餐旅程拆成清晰、可重複的階段：

1. 進入與服務模式 — 品牌化的進入頁讓顧客選擇外送或自取並確認地點，在瀏覽菜單前先建立情境。
2. 探索 — 首頁整合搜尋、促銷輪播與餐廳列表，幫助顧客快速找到目標——或掃描桌號 QR 後直接進入綁定餐廳菜單。
3. 餐廳詳情 — 主視覺、評分、菜系標籤、外送資訊與營業時間，在加入第一道菜前就建立信任。
4. 菜單導覽 — 分類標籤（推薦、麵食、套餐等）讓長菜單易於掃讀；底部固定購物車列顯示品項數與即時總額。
5. 餐點客製化 — 改碼群組（如肉類選擇與加價）以清楚的單選與數量步進器呈現，從源頭降低點錯機率。
6. 購物車與結帳 — 桌面版以側邊購物車常駐；手機版以底部操作列引導——兩者皆通往精簡的訪客結帳表單。

手機與桌面共用同一套設計語言——Eats365 橙色點綴、乾淨白底、誘人的美食攝影——無論顧客在桌上用手機點餐或在較大螢幕瀏覽，體驗都保持一致。

subtitle.en: Designed for Guests Who Want to Order — Not Learn a System
subtitle.zh: 為想點餐的顧客而設，而非讓他們先學會一套系統

body.en:
Key design decisions grounded in real dining behaviour:

• Delivery / Pickup toggle up front — Service mode is visible from the first screen, so guests never order under the wrong context.
• Location-aware entry — Address and area selection appear early, matching how Hong Kong users think about delivery feasibility.
• Visual menus that sell — Large dish photos, short descriptions, and discount tags (e.g. 20% Off) turn the digital menu into a merchandising surface — not just a price list.
• Sticky cart affordance — A persistent bottom bar (mobile) and side panel (desktop) keep order status visible without leaving the menu.
• Modifier clarity — Required choices are grouped and labelled; price changes (+$12) are shown inline so guests confirm exactly what they're paying for.
• Brand theming built in — Logo placement, accent colour, and hero imagery slots let each restaurant feel distinct while staying within the Eats365 system.
• No app download — Web-based UI works on any smartphone browser after a QR scan, lowering the barrier for first-time and tourist diners.
• Responsive parity — Mobile flows cover the full order path; desktop adds sidebar filtering and wider menu layouts for back-office or kiosk-style browsing.
body.zh:
以真實用餐行為為基礎的關鍵設計決策：

• 外送／自取切換置頂 — 服務模式從第一屏就可見，避免顧客在錯誤情境下點餐。
• 地點導向的進入流程 — 地址與區域選擇提前出現，符合香港用戶對外送可行性的思考方式。
• 會賣菜的視覺菜單 — 大尺寸菜品圖、簡短描述與折扣標籤（如 8 折），讓數位菜單成為推銷介面，而不只是價目表。
• 固定購物車提示 — 手機底部列與桌面側欄讓訂單狀態隨時可見，無需離開菜單頁。
• 改碼清晰可讀 — 必選項目分組標示；加價（如 +$12）inline 顯示，讓顧客確認所付即所得。
• 內建品牌主題 — Logo 位置、強調色與主視覺圖槽位，讓每家餐廳保有獨特感，同時維持 Eats365 系統一致性。
• 無需下載 App — 掃碼後即可在瀏覽器完成點餐，降低首次與旅客用戶的使用門檻。
• 響應式體驗對等 — 手機版涵蓋完整點餐路徑；桌面版加入側欄篩選與更寬的菜單版面，適合後台或自助機式瀏覽。
